description: FDA drug shortage listings (openFDA): generic name, availability status (e.g. Available, Currently in Shortage), manufacturer, package NDC, posting dates and FDA contact number. Up to 10 listings per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_fda_adverse_events_faers when you need FDA FAERS drug adverse event reports for a generic drug; health_fda_medical_device_510k when you need FDA 510 premarket notifications: K-number, device name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
